WITH same_stores AS (
    SELECT
        StoreKey
    FROM retail.FactSales
    WHERE toYear(DateKey) IN (2008, 2009)
    GROUP BY StoreKey
    HAVING sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2008) > 0
       AND sumIf(SalesAmount, toYear(DateKey) = 2009) > 0
)
SELECT
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2008) AS sales_2008,
    sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2009) AS sales_2009,
    round(
        (sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2009) - sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2008))
        / nullIf(sumIf(fs.SalesAmount, toYear(fs.DateKey) = 2008), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS same_store_sales_growth_pct
FROM retail.FactSales AS fs
INNER JOIN same_stores AS ss ON fs.StoreKey = ss.StoreKey
WHERE toYear(fs.DateKey) IN (2008, 2009);
